title: Reference sources
subtitle: Public Git repositories, paths on the Runtime machine or library documents that agents may read (read-only) while running a process.

row.checkForbidden: Only platform administrators can test this source.

forbidden: You do not have permission to view this page.
needTenant: Select a company to view its sources.

field.keyHint: 2–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Cannot be changed after creation.
field.descHint: A short note so the agent knows what this source is for.

git.publicOnly: Public repositories only. Private repositories are not supported yet.

local.warning: This path is on the machine that runs the Runtime, not on your computer. It must be inside a configured root directory.

view.localNote: Only platform administrators can see and edit the path of a local-path source.

check.saveFirst: Save the source first, then test the connection.
check.dirty: You have unsaved changes. Save before testing.

key.invalid: The key must be 2–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

url.https: The URL must start with https://.
url.credential: Do not put a username or password in the URL. Use a public repository only.
url.tooLong: The URL can be at most 2048 characters.

branch.dash: A branch name cannot start with “-”.
branch.tooLong: A branch name can be at most 255 characters.

path.tooLong: The path can be at most 1024 characters.

desc.tooLong: The description can be at most 500 characters.

apiError.SOURCE_KEY_TAKEN: The key “{{key}}” is already used in this company.
apiError.SOURCE_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: This host is not allowed. Only public Git repositories on hosts your administrators have allowed are supported.
apiError.SOURCE_FORBIDDEN_KIND: Only platform administrators can create, edit, delete or test local-path sources.
apiError.SOURCE_UNRESOLVABLE: Could not read this source. Check the URL, branch or path and try again.
apiError.SOURCE_TOO_LARGE: The source is too large: at most 50 MB and 2,000 files after filtering. Narrow the source or the allowed paths.
apiError.SOURCE_IN_USE: You cannot change the type of a source that processes use.
apiError.TIMEOUT: No response from the Runtime. Try again later.
apiError.GENERIC: The action could not be completed. Try again later.

delete.title: Delete source {{key}}?
delete.body: Processes no longer use this source. Runs already using a pinned version are not affected.
delete.blockedBody: This source is used by the processes below. Remove it from these stages before deleting.
